dimensions.assessment: Applies to federal employees who receive voluntary separation incentives and the federal agencies offering them.
Changes the cap on separation incentives to a maximum of six months of pay determined by agency heads.
dimensions.evidence: not to exceed 6 month's pay at the rate received immediately before separation

dimensions.assessment: Modifies the statutory ceiling on incentive payments, which could alter federal agency spending on departures depending on agency implementation.
Amends a single section of title 5, United States Code, concerning separation incentives.
dimensions.evidence: To amend section 3523 of title 5, United States Code, to increase the limit on voluntary separation incentive payments

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to the statutory calculation limit for federal early separation incentives across the federal government.

missing_information: Total number of federal employees expected to take early separation incentives
Total estimated cost to the federal budget
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends federal law to increase the limit on voluntary separation incentive payments for federal employees up to six months of pay, affecting federal agencies and separating employees.
